interpretation: Synthetic uniform and mirrored food stimuli applied to sampled inherited circuits with empty neural state and disabled plasticity. The reported response is half the difference between right-rich and left-rich motor imbalance. These are circuit diagnostics, not physical navigation or within-lifetime learning tests. Descendants are samples within four selected source populations, not independent replicates.
